tagline: Español de España, en plan bien.

hero.title: Spanish of Spain, de verdad.
hero.blurb: Eighteen weeks. Short daily lessons. A buddy who walks you from total beginner to the doorstep of C1, in real Castilian Spanish — the Spanish you'll actually hear in Madrid, opinions, irony, paperwork and all.

bullets.text: vosotros, vale, tapas, the 'th' sound, and the irony. Not neutral, not Latin American.
the whole spine — ser/estar, the past tenses, all four subjunctives, si-clauses — plus the register nerve to actually use them.
15 to 35 minutes, sized to fit your day.
your progress saves to this device.

levels.title: A1 Foundations
levels.blurb: Greet, introduce yourself, order tapas, describe your day.

levels.title: A2 Building
levels.blurb: Tell stories in the past. Travel, health, everyday life.

levels.title: B1 Threshold
levels.blurb: Opinions, hypotheticals, real conversations — and the subjunctive without fear.

levels.title: B2 Depth
levels.blurb: Nuance, all four subjunctives, the full si-clause system, and storytelling in layers.

levels.title: C1 Gateway
levels.blurb: Irony, register-switching, the street heard honestly, and the grown-up machinery of a life in Spain. Preparing the leap, not certifying it.
